=== /opt/soulpilates docker-compose.prod.yml ===
# Soul Pilates — PRODUCTION Stack
#
#  Assumes you've copied soulpilates-backend-latest.tar.gz and
#  soulpilates-frontend-latest.tar.gz onto the host and loaded them with:
#    docker load < soulpilates-backend-latest.tar.gz
#    docker load < soulpilates-frontend-latest.tar.gz
#
#  Then:
#    cp prod.env.sample prod.env  # edit secrets
#    docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
#
#  External access (mongosh / redis-cli from your dev machine):
#    MongoDB → host:${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT}   (default 27117)
#    Redis   → host:${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT}   (default 6479)
#    Both are auth-protected. Restrict access at the firewall to trusted IPs:
#      ufw allow from <your-ip> to any port 27117
#      ufw allow from <your-ip> to any port 6479
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

services:

  mongo:
    image: mongo:8
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Exposed on a non-default host port so the operator can run mongosh
      # from a dev machine. Auth is mandatory (MONGO_USER / MONGO_PASSWORD).
      # Restrict via firewall: ufw allow from <trusted-ip> to any port ${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT}
      - "127.0.0.1:${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT:-27117}:27017"
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${MONGO_USER}
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MONGO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ./data/mongo:/data/db
    command: ["mongod", "--bind_ip_all"]
    networks: [internal]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Exposed on a non-default host port for direct redis-cli access.
      # Protected by REDIS_PASSWORD via --requirepass.
      # Restrict via firewall: ufw allow from <trusted-ip> to any port ${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT}
      - "127.0.0.1:${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT:-6479}:6379"
    volumes:
      - ./data/redis:/data
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"]
    networks: [internal]

  rustfs-volume-init:
    image: alpine:3.20
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs-init
    volumes:
      - ./data/rustfs:/data
    command: sh -c "chown -R 10001:10001 /data"
    restart: "no"

  rustfs:
    image: rustfs/rustfs:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:6324:9000"      # S3 API — exposed so the public can fetch images
      - "127.0.0.1:6325:9001"
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
      RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ENABLE: "true"
    volumes:
      - ./data/rustfs:/data
    depends_on:
      rustfs-volume-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks: [internal, public]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9000/health"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 10s

  # One-shot that creates the soulpilates-public bucket (idempotent).
  # Runs after rustfs is healthy so it never races the S3 API startup.
  # Sets anonymous download policy so the frontend can fetch images directly.
  rustfs-bucket-init:
    image: minio/mc:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs-bucket-init
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
    entrypoint: >
      /bin/sh -c "
        mc alias set rustfs http://rustfs:9000 $$RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY $$RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY &&
        mc mb --ignore-existing rustfs/soulpilates-public &&
        mc anonymous set download rustfs/soulpilates-public &&
        echo 'Bucket soulpilates-public ready.'
      "
    depends_on:
      rustfs:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks: [internal]

  backend:
    image: soulpilates/backend:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8391:8080"
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Production
      ASPNETCORE_URLS: http://+:8080
      MongoDbSettings__ConnectionString: "mongodb://${MONGO_USER}:${MONGO_PASSWORD}@mongo:27017/?authSource=admin"
      MongoDbSettings__DatabaseName: soulpilates
      JwtSettings__Secret: ${JWT_SECRET}
      # P4-S12 — optional previous-key slot for the rotation grace window.
      # Empty string is interpreted by Program.cs as "no previous key" (single-key mode).
      JwtSettings__PreviousSecret: ${JWT_PREVIOUS_SECRET:-}
      # Google Sign-in / Sign-up. Empty by default → feature self-gates OFF
      # (routes 404, button hidden). Populate GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID /
      # GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI in prod.env to enable.
      GoogleAuth__ClientId: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}
      GoogleAuth__ClientSecret: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      GoogleAuth__RedirectUri: ${GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI:-}
      StorageSettings__Endpoint: "http://rustfs:9000"
      StorageSettings__AccessKey: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      StorageSettings__SecretKey: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
      StorageSettings__PublicBucket: soulpilates-public
      StorageSettings__PublicUrlBase: ${PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL_BASE}
      StorageSettings__ForcePathStyle: "true"
      StripeSettings__SecretKey: ${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY}
      StripeSettings__PublishableKey: ${STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}
      StripeSettings__WebhookSecret: ${STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET}
      StripeSettings__Enabled: ${STRIPE_ENABLED}
      # ───── SMTP / Email ─────
      SmtpSettings__Host: ${SMTP_HOST}
      SmtpSettings__Port: ${SMTP_PORT:-587}
      SmtpSettings__Username: ${SMTP_USERNAME}
      SmtpSettings__Password: ${SMTP_PASSWORD}
      SmtpSettings__FromEmail: ${SMTP_FROM_EMAIL}
      SmtpSettings__FromName: ${SMTP_FROM_NAME:-Soul Pilates Da Nang}
      SmtpSettings__Enabled: ${SMTP_ENABLED:-true}
      SmtpSettings__EmailRegisterVerificationEnabled: ${SMTP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED:-true}
      # Email test-mode safety net: when TestMode=true, real customers never get
      # mail — everything is redirected to TestRedirectTo (or dropped), except
      # addresses in TestAllowlist which still receive the real email.
      SmtpSettings__TestMode: ${SMTP_TEST_MODE:-false}
      SmtpSettings__TestRedirectTo: ${SMTP_TEST_REDIRECT_TO:-}
      SmtpSettings__TestAllowlist: ${SMTP_TEST_ALLOWLIST:-}
      # ───── Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel + Conversions API ─────
      MetaTracking__PixelId: ${META_PIXEL_ID:-}
      MetaTracking__AccessToken: ${META_CAPI_TOKEN:-}
      MetaTracking__TestEventCode: ${META_CAPI_TEST_CODE:-}
      MetaTracking__Enabled: ${META_TRACKING_ENABLED:-true}
      # ───── TikTok Pixel + Events API ─────
      TiktokTracking__PixelCode: ${TIKTOK_PIXEL_CODE:-}
      TiktokTracking__AccessToken: ${TIKTOK_EVENTS_TOKEN:-}
      TiktokTracking__TestEventCode: ${TIKTOK_TEST_EVENT_CODE:-}
      TiktokTracking__Enabled: ${TIKTOK_TRACKING_ENABLED:-true}
      # ───── Web Push (VAPID) ─────
      WebPush__Enabled: ${WEBPUSH_ENABLED:-true}
      WebPush__Subject: ${WEBPUSH_SUBJECT:-mailto:admin@soulpilates.com.vn}
      WebPush__PublicKey: ${WEBPUSH_PUBLIC_KEY}
      WebPush__PrivateKey: ${WEBPUSH_PRIVATE_KEY}
      # ───── Seed & CORS ─────
      AdminSeed__Enabled: "true"
      AdminSeed__Email: ${ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL}
      AdminSeed__Password: ${ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD}
      AdminSeed__Name: "Soul Pilates Admin"
      # CORS — single origin in path-split deployment
      CorsSettings__AllowedOrigins__0: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL}
      # ───── Public site (customer-facing absolute URLs in emails) ─────
      # EmailService builds verify-email, reset-password and "view account"
      # links against this base. Must match the host VestaCP serves publicly.
      PublicSite__BaseUrl: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL}
      # ───── Timezone ─────
      TZ: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
      # ───── Observability ─────
      SentrySettings__Dsn: ${SENTRY_DSN}
    volumes:
      - ./data/soulpilates-api-logs:/var/log/soulpilates-api
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      rustfs-bucket-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks: [internal, public]

  frontend:
    image: soulpilates/frontend:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3719:80"
    networks: [public]


  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # GlitchTip (Sentry-compatible self-hosted error tracker) — P4-S10
  #
  # ALL FOUR SERVICES ARE INTERNAL-ONLY. There is no `ports:` mapping on the
  # `glitchtip` web service — the operator reaches the UI by SSH-tunneling
  # port 8000:
  #
  #     ssh -L 8000:localhost:8000 prod-host
  #     # then open http://localhost:8000 in a browser
  #
  # This matches the studio's existing security posture: admin surfaces are
  # tunneled, not internet-facing.
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  glitchtip-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: glitchtip
      POSTGRES_USER: glitchtip
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ./data/glitchtip-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data/glitchtip-redis:/data
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip:
    image: glitchtip/glitchtip:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://glitchtip:${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@glitchtip-postgres:5432/glitchtip
      REDIS_URL: redis://glitchtip-redis:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ${GLITCHTIP_SECRET_KEY}
      PORT: "8000"
      GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN: ${GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN}
      # 30-day event retention — aligned with B2 Object Lock (P4-S11) so the
      # forensic window for both operational systems matches.
      GLITCHTIP_DEFAULT_EVENT_LIFETIME_DAYS: "30"
      EMAIL_URL: ${GLITCHTIP_EMAIL_URL:-consolemail://}
      DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL: ${GLITCHTIP_FROM_EMAIL:-glitchtip@soulpilates.com.vn}
    # NO ports: mapping — SSH tunnel only.
    depends_on: [glitchtip-postgres, glitchtip-redis]
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip-worker:
    image: glitchtip/glitchtip:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ./bin/run-celery-with-beat.sh
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://glitchtip:${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@glitchtip-postgres:5432/glitchtip
      REDIS_URL: redis://glitchtip-redis:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ${GLITCHTIP_SECRET_KEY}
      GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN: ${GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN}
      GLITCHTIP_DEFAULT_EVENT_LIFETIME_DAYS: "30"
      EMAIL_URL: ${GLITCHTIP_EMAIL_URL:-consolemail://}
      DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL: ${GLITCHTIP_FROM_EMAIL:-glitchtip@soulpilates.com.vn}
    depends_on: [glitchtip-postgres, glitchtip-redis]
    networks: [internal]

# Soul Pilates — PRODUCTION Stack
#
#  Assumes you've copied soulpilates-backend-latest.tar.gz and
#  soulpilates-frontend-latest.tar.gz onto the host and loaded them with:
#    docker load < soulpilates-backend-latest.tar.gz
#    docker load < soulpilates-frontend-latest.tar.gz
#
#  Then:
#    cp prod.env.sample prod.env  # edit secrets
#    docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
#
#  External access (mongosh / redis-cli from your dev machine):
#    MongoDB → host:${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT}   (default 27117)
#    Redis   → host:${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT}   (default 6479)
#    Both are auth-protected. Restrict access at the firewall to trusted IPs:
#      ufw allow from <your-ip> to any port 27117
#      ufw allow from <your-ip> to any port 6479
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

services:

  mongo:
    image: mongo:8
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Exposed on a non-default host port so the operator can run mongosh
      # from a dev machine. Auth is mandatory (MONGO_USER / MONGO_PASSWORD).
      # Restrict via firewall: ufw allow from <trusted-ip> to any port ${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT}
      - "127.0.0.1:${MONGO_PUBLIC_PORT:-27117}:27017"
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: ${MONGO_USER}
      MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MONGO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ./data/mongo:/data/db
    command: ["mongod", "--bind_ip_all"]
    networks: [internal]

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Exposed on a non-default host port for direct redis-cli access.
      # Protected by REDIS_PASSWORD via --requirepass.
      # Restrict via firewall: ufw allow from <trusted-ip> to any port ${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT}
      - "127.0.0.1:${REDIS_PUBLIC_PORT:-6479}:6379"
    volumes:
      - ./data/redis:/data
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"]
    networks: [internal]

  rustfs-volume-init:
    image: alpine:3.20
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs-init
    volumes:
      - ./data/rustfs:/data
    command: sh -c "chown -R 10001:10001 /data"
    restart: "no"

  rustfs:
    image: rustfs/rustfs:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:6324:9000"      # S3 API — exposed so the public can fetch images
      - "127.0.0.1:6325:9001"
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
      RUSTFS_CONSOLE_ENABLE: "true"
    volumes:
      - ./data/rustfs:/data
    depends_on:
      rustfs-volume-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks: [internal, public]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9000/health"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 10s

  # One-shot that creates the soulpilates-public bucket (idempotent).
  # Runs after rustfs is healthy so it never races the S3 API startup.
  # Sets anonymous download policy so the frontend can fetch images directly.
  rustfs-bucket-init:
    image: minio/mc:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-rustfs-bucket-init
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
    entrypoint: >
      /bin/sh -c "
        mc alias set rustfs http://rustfs:9000 $$RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY $$RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY &&
        mc mb --ignore-existing rustfs/soulpilates-public &&
        mc anonymous set download rustfs/soulpilates-public &&
        echo 'Bucket soulpilates-public ready.'
      "
    depends_on:
      rustfs:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks: [internal]

  backend:
    image: soulpilates/backend:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8391:8080"
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Production
      ASPNETCORE_URLS: http://+:8080
      MongoDbSettings__ConnectionString: "mongodb://${MONGO_USER}:${MONGO_PASSWORD}@mongo:27017/?authSource=admin"
      MongoDbSettings__DatabaseName: soulpilates
      JwtSettings__Secret: ${JWT_SECRET}
      # P4-S12 — optional previous-key slot for the rotation grace window.
      # Empty string is interpreted by Program.cs as "no previous key" (single-key mode).
      JwtSettings__PreviousSecret: ${JWT_PREVIOUS_SECRET:-}
      # Google Sign-in / Sign-up. Empty by default → feature self-gates OFF
      # (routes 404, button hidden). Populate GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID /
      # GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET / GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI in prod.env to enable.
      GoogleAuth__ClientId: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:-}
      GoogleAuth__ClientSecret: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:-}
      GoogleAuth__RedirectUri: ${GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI:-}
      StorageSettings__Endpoint: "http://rustfs:9000"
      StorageSettings__AccessKey: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      StorageSettings__SecretKey: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}
      StorageSettings__PublicBucket: soulpilates-public
      StorageSettings__PublicUrlBase: ${PUBLIC_MEDIA_URL_BASE}
      StorageSettings__ForcePathStyle: "true"
      StripeSettings__SecretKey: ${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY}
      StripeSettings__PublishableKey: ${STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY}
      StripeSettings__WebhookSecret: ${STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET}
      StripeSettings__Enabled: ${STRIPE_ENABLED}
      # ───── SMTP / Email ─────
      SmtpSettings__Host: ${SMTP_HOST}
      SmtpSettings__Port: ${SMTP_PORT:-587}
      SmtpSettings__Username: ${SMTP_USERNAME}
      SmtpSettings__Password: ${SMTP_PASSWORD}
      SmtpSettings__FromEmail: ${SMTP_FROM_EMAIL}
      SmtpSettings__FromName: ${SMTP_FROM_NAME:-Soul Pilates Da Nang}
      SmtpSettings__Enabled: ${SMTP_ENABLED:-true}
      SmtpSettings__EmailRegisterVerificationEnabled: ${SMTP_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED:-true}
      # Email test-mode safety net: when TestMode=true, real customers never get
      # mail — everything is redirected to TestRedirectTo (or dropped), except
      # addresses in TestAllowlist which still receive the real email.
      SmtpSettings__TestMode: ${SMTP_TEST_MODE:-false}
      SmtpSettings__TestRedirectTo: ${SMTP_TEST_REDIRECT_TO:-}
      SmtpSettings__TestAllowlist: ${SMTP_TEST_ALLOWLIST:-}
      # ───── Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel + Conversions API ─────
      MetaTracking__PixelId: ${META_PIXEL_ID:-}
      MetaTracking__AccessToken: ${META_CAPI_TOKEN:-}
      MetaTracking__TestEventCode: ${META_CAPI_TEST_CODE:-}
      MetaTracking__Enabled: ${META_TRACKING_ENABLED:-true}
      # ───── TikTok Pixel + Events API ─────
      TiktokTracking__PixelCode: ${TIKTOK_PIXEL_CODE:-}
      TiktokTracking__AccessToken: ${TIKTOK_EVENTS_TOKEN:-}
      TiktokTracking__TestEventCode: ${TIKTOK_TEST_EVENT_CODE:-}
      TiktokTracking__Enabled: ${TIKTOK_TRACKING_ENABLED:-true}
      # ───── Web Push (VAPID) ─────
      WebPush__Enabled: ${WEBPUSH_ENABLED:-true}
      WebPush__Subject: ${WEBPUSH_SUBJECT:-mailto:admin@soulpilates.com.vn}
      WebPush__PublicKey: ${WEBPUSH_PUBLIC_KEY}
      WebPush__PrivateKey: ${WEBPUSH_PRIVATE_KEY}
      # ───── Seed & CORS ─────
      AdminSeed__Enabled: "true"
      AdminSeed__Email: ${ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL}
      AdminSeed__Password: ${ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD}
      AdminSeed__Name: "Soul Pilates Admin"
      # CORS — single origin in path-split deployment
      CorsSettings__AllowedOrigins__0: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL}
      # ───── Public site (customer-facing absolute URLs in emails) ─────
      # EmailService builds verify-email, reset-password and "view account"
      # links against this base. Must match the host VestaCP serves publicly.
      PublicSite__BaseUrl: ${PUBLIC_APP_URL}
      # ───── Timezone ─────
      TZ: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh
      # ───── Observability ─────
      SentrySettings__Dsn: ${SENTRY_DSN}
    volumes:
      - ./data/soulpilates-api-logs:/var/log/soulpilates-api
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_started
      redis:
        condition: service_started
      rustfs-bucket-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    networks: [internal, public]

  frontend:
    image: soulpilates/frontend:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3719:80"
    networks: [public]


  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # GlitchTip (Sentry-compatible self-hosted error tracker) — P4-S10
  #
  # ALL FOUR SERVICES ARE INTERNAL-ONLY. There is no `ports:` mapping on the
  # `glitchtip` web service — the operator reaches the UI by SSH-tunneling
  # port 8000:
  #
  #     ssh -L 8000:localhost:8000 prod-host
  #     # then open http://localhost:8000 in a browser
  #
  # This matches the studio's existing security posture: admin surfaces are
  # tunneled, not internet-facing.
  # ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  glitchtip-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: glitchtip
      POSTGRES_USER: glitchtip
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ./data/glitchtip-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data/glitchtip-redis:/data
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip:
    image: glitchtip/glitchtip:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://glitchtip:${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@glitchtip-postgres:5432/glitchtip
      REDIS_URL: redis://glitchtip-redis:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ${GLITCHTIP_SECRET_KEY}
      PORT: "8000"
      GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN: ${GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN}
      # 30-day event retention — aligned with B2 Object Lock (P4-S11) so the
      # forensic window for both operational systems matches.
      GLITCHTIP_DEFAULT_EVENT_LIFETIME_DAYS: "30"
      EMAIL_URL: ${GLITCHTIP_EMAIL_URL:-consolemail://}
      DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL: ${GLITCHTIP_FROM_EMAIL:-glitchtip@soulpilates.com.vn}
    # NO ports: mapping — SSH tunnel only.
    depends_on: [glitchtip-postgres, glitchtip-redis]
    networks: [internal]

  glitchtip-worker:
    image: glitchtip/glitchtip:latest
    container_name: soulpilates-prod-glitchtip-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ./bin/run-celery-with-beat.sh
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://glitchtip:${GLITCHTIP_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@glitchtip-postgres:5432/glitchtip
      REDIS_URL: redis://glitchtip-redis:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ${GLITCHTIP_SECRET_KEY}
      GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN: ${GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN}
      GLITCHTIP_DEFAULT_EVENT_LIFETIME_DAYS: "30"
      EMAIL_URL: ${GLITCHTIP_EMAIL_URL:-consolemail://}
      DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL: ${GLITCHTIP_FROM_EMAIL:-glitchtip@soulpilates.com.vn}
    depends_on: [glitchtip-postgres, glitchtip-redis]
    networks: [internal]

1:# Soul Pilates CRM — Full System Documentation
10:## 1. What this system is
28:## 2. Technology stack
33:| Database | MongoDB 8 (driver 3.7) |
37:| Payments | Stripe (embedded Checkout / PaymentIntents), keys AES-encrypted in DB |
46:### Solution projects
50:- **SoulPilates.Infrastructure** — `MongoDbContext` (thin Mongo access layer).
56:## 3. Application startup & cross-cutting architecture (`Program.cs`)
60:### Logging & error tracking
61:- **Serilog** is bootstrapped *before* the host so startup failures (Mongo refused,
68:### Dependency injection (lifetimes)
69:- **Singletons:** `MongoDbContext`, `IMediaStorage` (RustFS/S3), `IDocumentRenderer`
73:  `IPaymentService`, `IAccountingService`, `IWalletService`, `ISettingsService`, …).
77:### Hosted (background) services
91:### Authentication & authorization
104:### Rate limiting
110:### Middleware pipeline (order)
115:### Configuration & secrets
116:- Mongo, storage, admin-seed, web-push, Sentry, JWT all bound from configuration
118:- **Stripe keys** are *not* in config — they live **AES-256 encrypted in the settings
119:  document** and are managed from Settings → Payments. `PaymentService` decrypts on demand.
127:## 4. Data access (`MongoDbContext`)
129:A thin singleton wrapper over `IMongoDatabase`:
130:- Constructed from `MongoDbSettings` (connection string + database name).
131:- Exposes `Database` (raw `IMongoDatabase`, used by the export/backup feature) and a
132:  generic `GetCollection<T>(name)` used by every service.
135:  are stored as **ObjectId**, so raw mongosh queries must wrap ids in `ObjectId(...)`.
136:- The app reads settings from the **`Settings`** collection (a stray `GlobalSettings`
137:  collection also exists but is not the source of truth).
144:## 5. Data model (collections & entities)
148:### 5.1 Scheduling & booking
152:- **Attendance** — one booking of a client on a session (the core booking record). `Status` (RESERVED/BOOKED/CHECKED_IN(ARRIVED)/CANCELLED/LATE_CANCEL/NO_SHOW), `PaymentMethod` (PAY_AT_STUDIO/PACKAGE_CREDIT/STRIPE_DEPOSIT/STRIPE_FULL), `AmountPaid`/`AmountDueAtStudio`, `Quantity` (multi-seat), `PackageInstanceId` (credit used), `BookingReference` (SP-YYMMDD-####), denormalised client contact, `BookingSource`/`MarketingSource`/`MarketingDetail` (attribution), `RemindersSent` (idempotency tags "24h"/"1h"), reschedule links, and imported commission/revenue for migrated rows.
156:### 5.2 Clients & customer accounts

Stack: ASP.NET Core + MongoDB 8 + Redis + RustFS (S3-compatible media) + Astro frontend + Stripe (embedded Checkout/PaymentIntents) + GlitchTip (self-hosted error tracking).
